definition: Source-by-source audit of six supplied scans. “Printed vocabulary” covers explicit word labels, word banks, the title and the lesson’s named grammar forms. “Additional vocabulary” covers useful content words in instructions, choices, examples and readings. “Useful expressions” covers source-printed collocations and language frames. Each glossary entry is unique within the lesson, belongs to one category, includes an Arabic meaning and a source excerpt, and lists every source image where it appears. Character names, isolated numerals, ordinary function words, sound/letter symbols and uncompleted dotted gaps are excluded unless they are lesson targets; place names and meaningful time phrases are included.

reconciliation.uniqueEntries: Every glossary id and normalized English term occurs once, belongs to exactly one category, and has one Arabic meaning.
reconciliation.sourceCoverage: Each entry sourceImages list is mirrored exactly in that category’s per-image id lists; source page and SHA-256 are included per image.
reconciliation.imageOccurrences: Per-image counts sum to occurrences.allReferences; entries appearing on multiple scans contribute one reference on each scan.
reconciliation.semanticReview: All six source scans were visually reviewed on 2026-11-14. Each entry and image reference was checked against the transcribed page; all nine inflected-form/image matches are recorded in review.inflectionChecks. Workbook p.12’s four printed listening time pairs were verified against its scan, and the page-10 “Look” and page-13 “cross” references were corrected. The song refrain and printed time phrases are retained.

review.method: Visually compared all six byte-preserved source scans with their page transcriptions; checked every vocabulary term, excerpt and source-image allocation against the corresponding scan; manually resolved the nine inflected-form/image matches listed below; corrected unsupported picture-only or page references; reconciled category and occurrence totals.
review.translationNote: Arabic meanings are editorial learner-support glosses; they are not claimed to be printed textbook translations.
review.scopeNote: Character names, ordinary function words, picture-only labels, isolated numerals, sound/letter symbols, and uncompleted dotted gaps remain excluded under the audit definition. All printed time expressions and the song refrain are retained.
